profile.name: VXI-11网络测试仪器
profile.description: 支持 VXI-11 协议的以太网测试测量仪器，如示波器、信号源、频谱分析仪或数字万用表等。此类仪器可通过局域网接入实验室自动化系统，用于远程发送命令、读取测量数据、触发采集、读取状态以及进行远程/本地控制切换。
profile.description_en: A LAN-connected test and measurement instrument that supports the VXI-11 protocol, such as an oscilloscope, signal generator, spectrum analyzer, or digital multimeter. These instruments are used in laboratory automation for remote command and data transfer, triggering, status reading, and switching between remote and local control.
